title: Design: Edit Line shows Title above the saved title
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have an open work order, work order 1, with a line, line 1, titled "Replace tie rod" with the description "excessive play".
  • Use a desktop browser window at full screen, at 100% zoom, so the window can be compared with the attached board picture.
  • Start on work order 1, on its Lines tab.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The Edit Line window opens for line 1 of work order 1.
  • The first box is white with a thin light grey border, with no grey background and no red line under it.
  • A small grey label reads exactly "Title", with no star after it, at the top left inside the box.
  • Under the label, "Replace tie rod" shows in dark text, exactly as saved.
  • The label reads "Title", where board 1.4 shows the question "What Are You Doing?" above the saved title.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "What Are You Doing / Why Are You Doing It?" (Title and Description), Confluence 845348896, version 15 (14 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11257, story SV-10130 (Story 1, The Work Order Line Dialog)

  • S1-R1: “The first field is labeled exactly "Title", with no asterisk.”
  • S1-R3: “The Title box carries the placeholder "What are you doing?" and the Description box carries "Why are you doing it?". Placeholder text shows while the box is empty and disappears as soon as there is a value. The labels Title and Description always sit at the top of their boxes, empty or filled, with the placeholder underneath; in production the label sat inside the empty box. This is the one layout change in the dialog.”

Not yet checked against a build by us: the QA build (sv10130.qa.shopview.com, QuickBooks host qb1.qa.shopview.com) and staging carry this change, and this case has not been run on either.

References from Design

Design canvas "What Are You Doing / Why Are You Doing It?" (https://claude.ai/artifact/Pz1Q6BfvreYFpQwVQZPTE6), copy re-read on 27 Oct 2026 (its one change since 13 Oct: the New Line board's "Title *" now reads "Title"): boards 1.5 "Edit Line - after", 1.4 "Edit Line - before". Compare the screen with the pictures below; the expected results above come from the quotes above where the PRD speaks, and from the board pictures where it is silent about the look.

Board 1.4 "Edit Line - before" is today's window and is attached only as the control.

Design pictures attached to this case:

  • board-1.5-edit-line-after.png
  • board-1.4-edit-line-before.png

The design's own words:

  • “Two labels, nothing else The floating labels now read Title and Description , so a filled field is named rather than interrogated. The empty Description still prompts with “Why are you doing it?” in sentence case.”
  • “The question is worst here With a value in the field, the label floats up and sits directly above the words it supposedly names. “Replace - Brake pot” reads as the answer to “What Are You Doing?” rather than as the name of the job, which is exactly how it then arrives in the shop's books.”
